author: EDJM9
body:
This is my first 5CP. My first map, Colors, was denied. I am working with Legoche to see how to improve it. But here it is, Jangate!

http://imgur.com/a/v53ot

Gameplay:

Every team starts with: One Kill = 0 points. For every hill controlled, it is +1 to the points gained from kills. Ex> 3 hills controlled = 3 points per kill. Each scorebox is 7 points. The first team to 175 points, or the team with the most points after 10 minutes wins!


Hope you all enjoy!

-EDJM9

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body:
I'm sorry, but your map has been denied. Since no other map developers put forward text or feedback, here's my response:

- It's too many capture points for a map of this size.
- For a map with its layout and player flow, it is too cramped.
- There will be often too much player crowding as to where a control point is, making it too hectic.
- Scoreboxes aren't really a thing on KoTH/CP maps.
- Slightly too small, and a lack of map info in original post.

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
This was already denied.

We regret to inform you that your map will not be added. We have declined it for the following reasons:
- It is too simple
- There is too much void
- There is not enough room for PvP
- Needs more block variation
- Capture points are too close
- Map needs to be expanded
- Not enough paths to the next point, going from middle to the second point can be rushed into 3 seconds and it'll be a fight to win the middle then literally push 2nd and last before they respawn. There's also a chokepoint, the staircases, and spawnkilling is extremely easy, along with holding the stairs.
- The map doesn't have a layout for a gameplay of one hill let alone five
- Not enough space

If changes are made, you may repost your map with the requests above, and reply to this comment. We will then reevaluate it for further action on whether or not it will be accepted.

Thank you very much for submitting!
